answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through ultra-wideband multilateration. Each agent broadcasts signed radio pulses to synchronized receivers stationed on a hillside terrace, a mountain summit, or a coastal pearl farm. This forces an adversary to deploy dedicated transceiver hardware and occupy scarce, non-overlapping physical space per identity. However, multipath reflections from nearby obstacles distort pulse arrival times, causing false rejections of honest agents.
